title: fix(console): the approvals inbox keeps its tab, filters, search and sort across a request page and Back
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTDAJKyXUan6fJCKsZUf5Pv)_

Fixes #36966

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 审批人在审批收件箱里切到「全部」、按状态筛选或搜索后打开一条申请，按浏览器返回，原来回到「待我审批」且筛选全清空；现在回到离开时的标签、筛选、搜索和排序，刷新页面也保留。
- 属于审批收件箱体验改进，替逐条处理「全部 → 已撤回」或「我提交的」的审批人省去每次重建筛选。
- 出错时最坏是收件箱打开在默认状态（与改动前一样），不丢数据、不影响审批动作；可直接撤回本次合并。
- 无

## What changes

The approvals inbox (`ApprovalsQueue` in `ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`) held its tab, status / process / object filters, search text and sort in `useState` alone, so the queue's remount on Back from a request's page reset them all. They now live in the inbox's query string, through a small codec beside the page, `approvalsInboxUrlState.ts` (the same shape as the metadata list's `metadataListState.ts`).

| Param | Carries | Default (no param) |
|---|---|---|
| `scope` | the tab: `submitted` or `all` | `pending` |
| `status` | one `APPROVAL_STATUSES` value, on tabs other than `pending` | every status |
| `process` | the process label a row shows | every process |
| `object` | the object machine name | every object |
| `q` | the search text | no search |
| `sort` | `oldest` or `amount` | `recent` |

Design points the card asked to settle:

- **Replace vs push.** Every write uses `setSearchParams(..., { replace: true })`, the tab change included, so filter changes add no history entries and Back leaves the inbox. Measured in the browser: after a tab switch, a sort change and a search, one Back from the inbox lands on the page before it.
- **Search debounce.** The search box keeps its own draft; the draft reaches `q` after 350 ms, the same delay the server search already used (the old `serverQuery` debounce is replaced by it, and on the paginated tabs `q` IS the server query). A row opened inside the debounce first writes the pending text into the inbox's own entry, then navigates, so Back returns to it too. The draft follows the address only on a navigation the page did not write (a link here, Back / Forward), never on its own REPLACE, the rule `ResourceListPage` uses; it is applied during render, not in an effect.
- **Invalid values.** Reading is strict and quiet: an unknown `scope` or `sort`, or a `status` outside `APPROVAL_STATUSES`, reads as the default. A `status` on the `pending` tab is ignored (that tab draws no status filter, so it would hide rows behind a control that is not shown). `process` and `object` name data, so they are checked once, at the first load that returns rows, and dropped only when those rows are the whole answer (the pending tab, or `rows.length >= total`) and none carries the value; otherwise the value is kept and offered in its dropdown (an object no loaded row labels shows by its machine name). A filter picked from the dropdowns is never second-guessed.
- **`onTabChange`.** It writes one patch: the new `scope`, and `status`, `process`, `object`, `q`, `sort` back to their defaults (deleted from the address). Params the inbox does not own are kept.
- **`?request=` deep link.** Unchanged: `ApprovalsInboxPage` still routes `?request=` to `RequestDeepLink` before the queue mounts, with or without inbox params beside it.
- **Record-page round trip and full reload.** Both restore: the state is read from the address on mount, and the first server read already carries `q` and `status` (no debounce wait on a reload).

Two choices worth a look:

- The tab rides `scope`, not the card's suggested `tab`: `tab` is a console-reserved param (`RECORD_DETAIL_TAB_PARAM`, the record page's detail tab, in app-shell's `urlParams.ts`), which that registry says a page must never repurpose. None of the six names is in `RESERVED_URL_PARAMS`.
- The state survives a reload. Object list views strip their `uf_*` state on a document reload (the list-draft rule in `listDraftStore.ts`); the inbox does not, because the card asks for reload survival and the inbox has no saved-view baseline to fall back to. If the reload reset is wanted here too, it is a follow-up, not part of this fix.

The status filter accepts the full `APPROVAL_STATUSES` vocabulary, so the status select's missing `cancelled` option (#36960, the next card in this area) only needs its option added; this PR does not touch the option list.

## Tests

New pin file `ApprovalsInboxPage.stateInUrl-36966.test.tsx` (8 cases, the real page under a memory router with a stub request page):

1. All + Recalled + object + sort + search, open a row, Back: same tab, selects, search, rows and address.
2. A fresh mount of the written address (a reload) opens the same inbox; the first server read already carries `q` and `status`.
3. A search typed and opened inside the debounce still comes back on Back.
4. Writes are REPLACE: after filter changes, one Back leaves the inbox.
5. Invalid control: unknown `scope` / `sort`, a `status` on the pending tab, and an unknown `status` value all read as defaults.
6. Full-set control: with every row loaded, a process / object no row carries reads as all and leaves the address; one a row carries is kept.
9. On a paginated tab whose first page lacks them, a process and object the address names are kept, in the address and in the controls (round 2, L1 S1).
7. A tab change clears the filters, search and sort from the address and keeps other params.
8. The `?request=` deep link still opens the request, with inbox params beside it, and the queue reads no list.

## Acceptance notes

- Server search on the paginated tabs matched only the object machine name in the showcase run (`q=invoice` found 4, `q=INV` and `q=Invoice` found 0). That is the server search, #36959's scope; noted, not touched here.
- The process and object selects only draw with two or more options among the loaded rows, so a search that narrows the rows to one object hides the object select while its filter still applies (shown as "N of M"). Unchanged by this PR.

## Verification

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/ApprovalsInboxPage.tsx`: the `openRequest` flush (writes the pending search into the current entry, then navigates) and the draft-follows-address block next to `useNavigationType`.
2. `ui/apps/console/src/pages/system/approvalsInboxUrlState.ts`: the codec and its defaults.
3. The seeded process / object check (`seedFiltersChecked`) in the page.

Two-minute check: open the approvals inbox, switch to All, set the status to Recalled, open a row, press Back. Expected: the All tab, Recalled, the same rows, and an address ending `?scope=all&status=recalled`.

<details><summary>Browser run (showcase on its own port, the Console from ui/ source via Vite, the issue's exact sequence)</summary>

Main's page source (tree-only restore of `0212714711`):

```

[main] 3-after-back:  {"url":".../system/approvals","tab":"My Pending4","combos":["All processes","All objects","Newest first"],"rows":4}

```
